title: Session view
description: Agents window session view: the ancestors the Agents composer's CSS is scoped to (`.part.sessionspart … .session-view …`). `variant="session"` is an open session's chat (`.chat-view.chat-view-chat.experimental-session-composer > .chat-view-widget > .interactive-session`); `variant="new"` is the new-session view (`.chat-view.chat-view-new > .sessions-chat-widget > .new-chat-widget-container`). These ancestors carry no captured styles of their own, so the view takes the size of its container.
usage: Wrap Agents window composers: `<vsc-workbench window="agents"><vsc-session-view><vsc-chat-input variant="session">` for an open session, `<vsc-session-view variant="new"><vsc-chat-input variant="new-session">` for the new-session view. Give it a width (the composer is 800-880px wide in the product).
